title: Here’s how much of Deutsche Bank’s market cap has been wiped away after reports on 15 million leaked documents
html:
Deutsche Bank saw as much as €3.8 billion ($4.2 billion) of its market cap wiped away after a team of media organizations wrote about a trove of 15 million leaked documents.

Deutsche Bank shares XE:DBK DB were down 5% in mid-morning trade after the Financial Times, the New York Times, Der Spiegel, Le Monde and other news organizations reported on the documents, which included the revelation that Deutsche Bank inadvertently leaked President Donald Trump’s tax documents.
